pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal patches with high-contrast, sharp-edged boundaries. Edge gradients show minimal blurring. Individual regions vary in size, with larger, more elongated shapes on the upper neck and smaller, more equilateral geometries on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of off-white inter-patch pathways. Junction nodes exhibit clear 3-way and 4-way intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, narrowing slightly towards the dorsal ridge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal mane presents a jagged, high-frequency silhouette against the background. Individual tufts create a regular sawtooth pattern with consistent amplitude along the visible portion of the neck.
